fields.label: Wt per Pcs (Kg)
fields.description: The linked Drawing's per-piece weight (Total Weight / No of Qty to Manufacture). Shown so this row's Total Weight can be read against the Transferred (Kg) on the Drawing Details row above, which is a whole-drawing figure.

fields.label: Total Weight (Kg)
fields.description: Auto-calculated: Qty (Nos) x Wt per Pcs (Kg). This is the figure that adds up into Total Consumed (Kg), which in turn seeds the next operation's Available to Consume (Kg) -- so it stays the row TOTAL and must not be repurposed to hold the per-piece weight.
